description_en: Light-blue zip-front one-piece swimsuit with white side-panel stripes and a high-cut leg, worn under an open light-blue track jacket with mesh side panels. Paired with a blue mesh tote and blue-and-white sneakers.
notes: Existing tags match (the 'mesh' tag refers to the bag and jacket panels). No bare legs shown, only the swimsuit and sneakers.

description_en: Teal-and-white gingham bikini set: halter top with a knotted front and a wrap-style tie skort/bottom. Worn with a sheer long cream cover-up with ruffle hem, a wide straw hat, a straw tote and white strappy sandals.
notes: Existing tags (mini, skirt, shorts, cardigan) miss that this is a gingham bikini; the 'cardigan' is a sheer kimono-style cover-up and the 'shorts' are a wrap skort-style bottom. Not clear if the bottom is a swim bottom.

description_en: Mint satin halter evening gown with a deep plunge neckline, ruched waist and a high thigh slit with a jeweled brooch, worn with matching long satin gloves, a pearl-and-crystal clutch and strappy rhinestone heels.
notes: Existing tags are correct but incomplete (no gown or clutch). Footwear is a heeled sandal with a sheer ankle panel.

description_en: Cropped black puffer jacket with a large faux-fur collar over a black rib-knit top with a lace yoke, a navy plaid mini skirt and sheer black tights. Fur-trimmed brown platform boots, fur earmuffs and a fur mini bag complete it.
notes: Tags agree with the image; footwear is fur-cuffed platform boots (tags only say 'boots'). The plaid mini gives a mild school-skirt read.

description_en: Taupe wool peacoat worn open over a beige ribbed square-neck top and a navy faux-leather mini skirt, with sheer black tights, chunky brown suede platform ankle boots, a navy beret and a small tweed chain bag.
notes: Existing tags agree ('khaki' is closer to taupe/beige). Boots are block-heel platform boots.

description_en: Black ruched one-shoulder fitted top with a silver collar necklace, low-rise washed grey wide-leg jeans and pointed black leather ankle boots, plus a black slouchy leather shoulder bag.
notes: Filed under summer but the outfit (long jeans, boots) is season-neutral. The footwear is mostly hidden under the hems. The existing 'leather' tag refers to the bag.

description_en: Sheer black ribbed turtleneck bodysuit/top with a dark bra visible through it, under a grey cable-knit button vest, with black wide-leg pleated trousers, black chunky loafers and a black leather tote.
notes: Existing tags omit the trousers. The top is see-through, showing a dark bra, so exposure is 1 rather than 0. The suit-like trousers and vest are the basis for the office roleplay read.

description_en: Cream ruffled off-the-shoulder rib knit top with a pink denim mini skirt under a beige belted trench coat, with white sheer knee socks and chunky white sneakers. Straw bucket hat and a lace-trimmed straw bag with a bow.
notes: Existing tags agree ('ivory/white/denim/socks'); the pink colour of the skirt is missing. Knee socks plus mini give a cute, schoolgirl-adjacent look.

description_en: Mint satin qipao-style mini dress with a keyhole cutout, white floral embroidery, a side slit and frog fastenings, worn with white lace-top thigh-high stockings and mint ankle-strap platform pumps.
notes: Existing tags omit the white stockings colour and the cutout/slit design. Stockings and heels are both worn; footwear field lists stockings.

description_en: Black satin underwire bra and ruffled lace-trim satin briefs with small bows, with sheer black thigh-high stockings with wide satin tops and black patent pointed stilettos with bows.
notes: Tags agree. The briefs show faint suspender-tab details at the sides, but no suspender belt is visible and the stockings are hold-up style.
